svg.title: How zot serves images
svg.desc: Registry clients such as docker, podman, skopeo, containerd, helm and oras talk to zot over the OCI Distribution Specification HTTP API, for example GET /v2/alpine/manifests/edge. zot stores the data on disk as an OCI image layout, with an oci-layout file, an index.json and a blobs/sha256 directory per repository.
